The mavros snapshot does not contain the Odometry definition itself; mavros publishes it (package.xml depends on nav_msgs). Topic name: the code writes "~/local" on plugin sub-node "global_position" whose namespace comes from the UAS node at run time; /mavros/global_position/local is the resolution under the snapshot's default launch namespace and the Python client default namespace. frame values are parameter defaults (frame_id "map", child_frame_id "base_link") that are watched and can be changed at run time. QoS: rclcpp::SensorDataQoS() fixes best_effort/volatile (depth 5); it sets no deadline, so deadline_ms is null. No publish rate is set in code; odometry is published once per received MAVLink GLOBAL_POSITION_INT (:297-420), so rate_hz is null. Twist: only twist.linear is set, from Eigen::Vector3d(gpos.vy, gpos.vx, gpos.vz) / 1E2 (:342-344); twist.angular is left zero and the twist covariance is marked unknown (vel_cov_out(0) = -1.0, :347-349).
